info.name: InvoiceFullStack API
info.description:
Complete API collection for InvoiceFullStack - Invoice generation and management system for Nigerian businesses.

Base URL: `/api/v1`

Authentication: Most endpoints require a JWT Bearer token.

body.raw:
{
  "email": "business@example.com",
  "password": "securePassword123",
  "confirm_password": "securePassword123",
  "name": "My Business Name",
  "type": "business",
  "phone": "+2348012345678",
  "first_name": "John",
  "last_name": "Doe",
  "logo": "https://example.com/logo.png",
  "address": "123 Business Street, Lagos, Nigeria"
}

request.description:
Create a new business/entity account.

**Required fields:** email, password, confirm_password, name

**Optional fields:** type, phone, first_name, last_name, logo, address

Authenticate an existing user.

**Note:** This request automatically saves the token to the environment variable `access_token`.
